corrosion_narrative: The average mild steel corrosion rate was 0.1002 MPY against the target of within 3.0 MPY, and the average copper corrosion rate was 0.0348 MPY against the target of within 0.5 MPY. Status: Excellent. Corrosion control was Excellent because both metals remained well below their target limits throughout the July reporting period.
corrosion_chart_comment: Corrosion remained well controlled during the month.
scale_narrative: Status: Acceptable. Traced Product averaged 45.66 ppm against the 40.85-45.15 ppm Controller Setpoint control range, with 47.9% of readings within range. Product was higher than target early in the month and moved closer to the control band later, but end-of-month control was still not consistently maintained. Conductivity remained stable and maintained within its setpoint configuration range, so the Traced Product deviation is not linked to water loss or dilution and should be addressed through product control optimisation.
scale_chart_comment: Traced Product remained outside consistent control at month end.
microbial_narrative: FRC data was not available in the field data for this reporting period and will be checked during the upcoming service visit. The July service note reported low ORP related to a clogged sample line; the line was unclogged and ORP spike response should be verified as sample flow stabilizes. Biocide pump was activated during the month, supporting an Acceptable microbial control status pending FRC and dip-slide confirmation.
orp_chart_comment: ORP spike response should be confirmed after sample-line service.
water_efficiency_narrative: Water efficiency was Excellent. Conductivity averaged 597.64 uS/cm against the 570-630 uS/cm Controller Setpoint range, with 83.7% of readings in range. Makeup conductivity was 224.4 uS/cm, target COC was 2.67, and actual COC was 2.66, giving only 0.4% deviation from target.
conductivity_chart_comment: Conductivity remained well maintained during the month.
product_efficiency_narrative: Product efficiency needs continued attention because Traced Product was within the Controller Setpoint range for only 47.9% of the reporting month. Polymer consumption rate averaged 83.9% and decreased from the start to the end of the month, indicating the issue was improving but still not fully resolved. Feed control logic should be optimised and product control should be verified during the upcoming service visit.
proactive_support_narrative: The July service note documented low ORP related to a clogged sample line, plus a recommendation to inspect the dosing pump, probe, onsite inventory, FRC level, and pH probe. The sample line was unclogged and the system should continue to be monitored to verify ORP recovery.
closing_summary: Overall July performance was strong for corrosion control and water efficiency, with conductivity and COC maintained close to target. The main follow-up items are to confirm ORP/FRC recovery after the sample-line service and continue improving Traced Product control until end-of-month performance is consistently maintained.
